adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, `isTeamAdminOrOwner` is computed as `(await isTeamAdmin(...)) && (await isTeamOwner(...))`, which requires the same user to satisfy both checks. Given the variable name and intended authorization branch, this likely should be logical OR to allow either team admins or team owners to add guests. As written, legitimate team admins (or owners) who don’t also pass the other predicate will be denied by `if (!isTeamAdminOrOwner && !isOrganizer && !isAttendee) ...`, breaking expected functionality.
